fullPassage: The recent "cycling as a lifestyle" craze has expressed itself in an increase in the number of active cyclists and in growth of cycling club membership in several European, American, Australian and Asian urban areas. It has also been accompanied by a symbolic reinterpretation of the bicycle. After the bicycle had been associated with poverty for many years, expensive recreational bicycles or recreationally-inspired commuting bicycles have suddenly become aspirational products in urban environments. In present times, cycling has become an activity which is also performed for its demonstrative value, its role in identity construction and its effectiveness in impressing others and signaling social status. To a certain extent, cycling has turned into a symbolic marker of the well-off. Obviously, value-laden consumption behavior is by no means limited to cycling. However, the link with identity construction and conspicuous consumption has become particularly manifest in the case of cycling.

✅ ② (A) 표명하다 — (B) 표현하다 ←정답
❌ ③ (A) 보내다 — (B) 표현하다 (A는 감정의 '표명'이지 물리적 '보내기'가 아님)
❌ ④ (A) 표명하다 — (B) 보내다 (B는 예술적 '표현')
det.tip: express: (감정/의견을) 표명하다 vs (예술로) 표현하다. 본문의 expressed itself = 스스로를 드러내다/나타내다

questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어는?

"a strong desire to achieve something high in status, especially in terms of social position or material wealth"

det.korean: 사회적 지위나 물질적 부에서 높은 것을 이루고자 하는 강한 열망 → aspiration
det.analysis:
✅ ① aspiration — 열망, 포부 ←정답
❌ ② indifference — 무관심 (반대 뉘앙스)
❌ ③ obligation — 의무 (열망이 아닌 강제성)
❌ ④ reluctance — 꺼림 (반대 뉘앙스)
det.tip: aspiration = 열망, 포부. aspirational products = 열망의 대상이 되는 제품

questions.passage: In present times, cycling has become an activity which is also performed for its __________ (demonstrate) value, its role in identity construction and its effectiveness in impressing others and signaling social status.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 자전거 타기는 '과시적' 가치를 위해 수행되는 활동이 되었다 → 형용사 demonstrative
det.analysis: __________ value → 명사(value)를 수식하는 형용사 자리. demonstrate(동사) → demonstrative(형용사)로 변환.
det.tip: demonstrate(증명하다, 과시하다) → demonstrative(과시적인, 형용사). demonstrative value = 과시적 가치

questions.passage: It has also been __________ (accompany) by a symbolic reinterpretation of the bicycle.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 이것은 자전거의 상징적 재해석이 '동반되었다' → 과거분사 accompanied
det.analysis: has been __________ → 현재완료 수동태(has been + p.p.) 자리. accompany(동사) → accompanied(과거분사)로 변환. be accompanied by = ~에 의해 동반되다.
det.tip: accompany(동반하다) → accompanied(과거분사). has been accompanied by = ~이 수반되었다

questions.passage: The recent "cycling as a lifestyle" craze has expressed itself in an increase in the number of active cyclists and in growth of cycling club membership in several European, American, Australian and Asian urban areas. It has also been accompanied by a symbolic reinterpretation of the bicycle. After the bicycle had been associated with poverty for many years, expensive recreational bicycles or recreationally-inspired commuting bicycles have suddenly become aspirational products in urban environments. In present times, cycling has become an activity which is also performed for its demonstrative value, its role in identity construction and its effectiveness in impressing others and signaling social status. To a certain extent, cycling has turned into __________. Obviously, value-laden consumption behavior is by no means limited to cycling. However, the link with identity construction and conspicuous consumption has become particularly manifest in the case of cycling.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 어느 정도, 자전거 타기는 '부유층의 상징적 표지'로 변했다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① a practical means of transportation — 실용적 교통수단 (본문 논지는 상징적 가치)
✅ ② a symbolic marker of the well-off — 부유층의 상징적 표지. 원문 정확 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ an outdated form of exercise — 구식 운동 형태 (본문에서 자전거 타기는 최신 열풍)
❌ ④ a sign of environmental awareness — 환경 인식의 표시 (본문에 환경 언급 없음)
det.tip: symbolic marker = 상징적 표지. well-off = 부유한, 잘 사는

ch: a symbolic marker of the well-off

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 정체성 구축과 '과시적 소비'의 연결이 자전거 타기의 경우에 특히 명백해졌다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① environmental sustainability — 환경적 지속 가능성 (본문에 환경 언급 없음)
❌ ② health improvement — 건강 개선 (본문 논지와 무관)
✅ ③ conspicuous consumption — 과시적 소비. 원문 정확 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ traffic congestion — 교통 혼잡 (본문에 교통 언급 없음)
det.tip: conspicuous consumption = 과시적 소비. 타인에게 보이기 위한 소비 행동
